text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy hasn't been feeling<n>well lately, so we
visit a local shrine<n>for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? That who I think it is? Hey,<n>Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh, Windy! What a coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Never thought I'd see ya here! Come<n>to do some
prayin'?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, I just thought I'd draw a<n>fortune slip.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The thing is, I'm going to be part of a<n>hero stage
show that they're holding<n>in the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I want to know if the show will turn<n>out good or not,
so I came to check on<n>my luck!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hmm. I bet you're gonna draw bad<n>luck for sure!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's the worst thing that could happen<n>before your
important show! Now<n>you're gonna get all nervous
and<n>mess up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You can try to spook me all<n>you want, but I
know it won't turn out<n>like that!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to make the show a grand<n>success! Here
goes nothing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nice! See? I got great luck! Now I'm<n>sure everything
will go just fine!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What do you have to say to that,<n>Windy?! Justice
always prevails!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Grrr... No! Evil will be the last one<n>standing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Rawr! Prepare for your end, Justice<n>Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! Curse you, Wicked Windy!<n>You'll never defeat
someone with a<n>virtuous soul!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins the struggle between<n>good and evil.
The two glare at each<n>other before engaging in a
heated<n>battle for the ages!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Not bad... I guess we'llcall it a draw for today!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Watch yourself, Wicked Windy! If you<n>ever run
amok again, I'll charge in to<n>halt your villainy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Just go ahead and try! Next time, you<n>won't even
land a finger on me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Our next battle will be where you<n>draw your last
breath! Mwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling energized after her clash with<n>a hero of
justice, Shinko Windy's<n>condition improves.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Gah! ...I drew terrible luck!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mwahahaha! Just like I told you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Your hero show's gonna be a<n>disaster for sure.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... But everyone is looking forward<n>to it so
much...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
H-hey! It's just a dumb fortune slip.<n>Don't take it
so seriously!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: B-but...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
C-c'mon, heroes aren't supposed to<n>get
depressed! You're my rival,<n>aren'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: So chin up already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy is crestfallen at Biko's<n>fortune, and
her condition remains<n>poor...
